rubric: The first child writes a quoting helper and the second may extend it: a reader can call that one piece of work in two children, or call the second's use a dependency. Confidence stays moderate.

reading.why: two readings are fair; see readings

criteria.no_overlap: Is every piece of the work in exactly one child?

readings.why: The quoting helper is written in the first child and extended by the second, which is one piece of work in two children.

criteria.no_overlap: Is every piece of the work in exactly one child?

readings.why: The second child only uses the helper, which is a dependency, not shared work.
